decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (EXISTING CEILING SECTION Rev. A, PROPOSED CEILING SECTION Rev. A, EXISTING PLANS Rev. A, Unnumbered location plan, DESIGN & ACCESS STATEMENT / HERTIAGE STATEMENT 12/08/2016. Received: 18/08/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The ceiling coving to be used shall be taken from a mould of the existing ceiling coving and match its materials, profile, design and dimensions.
description: Installation of soundproofing to the existing ceilings in entrance/hall area, bedroom and living room to the flat
